versions.subject: Added Atomic Blue Detections Repo
versions.detection:
selection1:
    Image:
        - '*net.exe'
    CommandLine:
        - '* time *'
selection2:
    CommandLine:
        - '*\\\*'
condition: selection1 and selection2

versions.subject: Update win_remote_time_discovery.yml
versions.detection:
selection:
  - Image|endswith: 
        - '\net.exe'
        - '\net1.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'time'
  - Image|endswith: '\w32tm.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'tz'
  - Image|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'Get-Date'
condition: selection
versions.spl: (Image IN ("*\\net.exe", "*\\net1.exe") CommandLine="*time*") OR (Image="*\\w32tm.exe" CommandLine="*tz*") OR (Image="*\\powershell.exe" CommandLine="*Get-Date*")
